sloka: अथ च अपि महा प्राज्ञ ब्राह्मणानाम् मया श्रुतम् ।पुरा पितृ गृहे सत्यम् वस्तव्यम् किल मे वने ॥२-२९-८॥
transliteration: atha ca api mahā prājña brāhmaṇānām mayā śrutam ।purā pitṛ gṛhe satyam vastavyam kila me vane ॥2-29-8॥

translations.english: O highly sagacious Rama I had also heard in my father's house long ago, from brahmins prophesing that some day I shall have certainly to dwell in the forest.
